calls.head: Sheltered against exposed
calls.body: On quality allowed, Winnipeg sits 16th of 32, at the sheltered end of the scale. Detroit is 28th, at the exposed end.
calls.call: Winnipeg keeps the shots it allows further from danger than Detroit does.

calls.head: Forecheck against patience
calls.body: On forecheck pressure, Detroit sits 19th of 32, at the hounding end of the scale. Winnipeg is 31st, at the passive end.
calls.call: Detroit puts more forecheck pressure on than Winnipeg.
calls.cite: Style fingerprint · this season blended with last · 1 and 1 games this season
calls.happened: On forecheck score (arena-adjusted, 100 is league average), Detroit had 161 and Winnipeg 78. Coming in, Detroit was at 94 and Winnipeg at 83.

surprises.head: Winnipeg won against the run of play
surprises.body: Replaying this game’s chances, Detroit comes out ahead 76 times in 100. Winnipeg won anyway.
